Frequently Asked Questions
What metrics does Document360's Analytics track for articles?

Document360 tracks views (unique clicks per browser), reads (engagement based on scrolling, clicking, and time spent on your article), likes, and dislikes for each article. These metrics are available at the article level and in aggregate across the entire knowledge base.

What does Document360's Search Analytics show?

Search Analytics identifies zero-result queries (searches that returned no articles), shows search-to-click ratios, and highlights popular search terms. This helps you spot content gaps and understand what readers are actively looking for.

Can I see article performance broken down by geography?

Yes. Document360's Geo Analytics tracks reader locations to show which countries are generating views. You can view article performance by country, filter by date, and export the data as a CSV.

Can I track team contributions through Document360 Analytics?

Yes. The User Analytics section shows articles created and updated per team member and includes a Top Performers view ranked by contributions. Contributors see stats only for articles they have created or updated; admins see organization-wide data.
